lessons.lesson: The generic 6-cell stress matrix (incl. drop_one_fold) is a SUPERSET of what frozen family folds() contracts accept; gate runners must use each family's own folds contract.

OILEV weekly quintile books on a DV-median-eligible 9-name universe produce 0.5..1.0 leg weights, structurally incompatible with the frozen 0.30 cap; universe and cap must be co-designed before freeze.

LOT residual-MAX: anchor lost (PF 0.72, MDD 79%) while the sign-inverted control WON (net +0.71, PF 1.34) - a control outperforming its anchor falsifies the mechanism; this shadow observation is recorded, not rescuable.
score_valid=true on all-zero finite metrics allowed a zero-position baseline to publish (launch-1 incident); scored drivers must refuse zero-position/out-of-contract publications.

The canonical global ledger is gitignored and machine-local; host migrations strand it. Registry transfer must be checksummed (ledger_package pattern) or a committed digest authority substituted; physical merge stays DEFERRED_UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED until owner supplies the historical ledger.
ILLIQ-AMIHUD was a 12/13-gate near-survivor rejected on symbol concentration 0.7055 > 0.70; concentration gates are binding even for otherwise-clean families.
Drop-one-symbol was vacuous when the dropped symbol held zero positions; drop-one must prove the dropped symbol held positions (non-vacuousness) in anchor or neighbour.

OILEV-V2 anchor sign was falsified by its own inverted control (+0.758 raw vs anchor -0.821): a firing control outweighs any narrative; inverted-control wins are falsification artifacts, never candidates.
BAB-LOWBETA died after native costs and funding (anchor -0.0199): coherent direction with negative after-cost expectancy is a reject; costs/funding are not tunable rescue levers.

TECHABORT discipline worked end-to-end: pre-metric crash consumed zero budget, fix touched driver only with science surface empty, W12R2 re-freeze + A7 delta authorization, BAB cells under W12R stayed valid; replication of this pattern is mandatory for V13.

Shadow-effect region: three measured control-arm observations (V12 inverted OI-flow, V11 LOT inversion, stocks vol-level sorting) may only be re-entered via the PLAN_crypto_v13 section 1.1 front door with |rho| <= 0.20 vs the frozen OILEV-V2 anchor AND its inverted control.
Coverage must fail closed: a missing data tail is a blocker, never a synthesized stale tail (G05).

MANDATORY FIX, binding, sequenced FIRST in Phase V14-P1 (V13 LIQEPIS cost anomaly): the V13 driver accrued execution costs per stamp rather than per fill — run_v13_cell.py hardcoded uniform tick_size 0.01 instead of loading perp-metadata tick sizes, so on sub-cent symbols slip = 0.01/price = 0.87..4.26 per unit traded vs corrected ~0.028 (~900x lower); cost_charged_sum 25.03 vs price-only PnL -0.31 (~3-4 orders above the frozen per-fill schedule). Verdict-invariant for V13 (anchor negative on price alone: expectancy<0 at zero cost, PF 0.0475, folds fail, MDD fail; rejected under inflated, corrected and zero costs; SIGN-INV mirror cannot rescue a failed anchor) but a latent cost-once violation in the kernel. V14 remediation: cost charged exactly once per fill — never per holding-day, never per stamp on open positions — pinned by hand-computed fixtures (many-small-positions long-hold book whose cost scales with fills not holding days; stress tiers differing from base and each other; cost-once across replay; observed-once/replay-never counters; zero-position refusal; A1 append serialization). The frozen V13 scorer re-run on V13 inputs must reproduce the V13 published numbers byte-consistently EXCEPT the LIQEPIS cost column, recorded as an append-only adjudication with verdict unchanged. Cost columns in V14 scored cells are broken out by fills vs holding terms.
